name: Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee
description: Jerry takes his comedy pals out for coffee in a selection of his classic automobiles. Larry David sums it up best when he says, 'You've finally made a show about nothing.'

Single Shot
videos.overview: Here’s a little bonus video for our Facebook fans that you won’t find on the CCC website. It’s a short we’re calling “Single Shot” featuring two of Jerry’s former guests, David Letterman and Jay Leno, talking about each other.

videos.title: Paley Center Screening Room with Jerry and Dave
videos.overview:
Hosted by David Letterman.  Jerry and Dave chat onstage for an hour discussing Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee and other topics.  Invite to the event appears on the Paley website as:

Jerry Seinfeld will present a fourth-season episode of his smash web series Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee, a uniquely personal and intimate look at comedy and life with such luminaries as David Letterman, Tina Fey, and Chris Rock. Jerry will discuss the production of this compelling and hilarious project, but unfortunately coffee is not allowed in the theater. Feel free to arrive in a fabulous vintage automobile, though. - See more at: http://www.paleycenter.org/2014-jerry-seinfeld#sthash.2NV2SGRB.dpuf

videos.title: Comedians in Cars Getting Cocaine (The Soup Parody)
videos.overview: "The Soup" host Joel McHale takes joy riding in a classic 1959 ride to new heights with "Veep" star Tony Hale. Who wants booger sugar?!

videos.title: Single Shot: Donuts
videos.overview: Jerry Seinfeld and his guests Tina Fey, Brian Regan, and Sarah Silverman converse about the most beloved of all pastries, the donut, in this episode of Comedians in Cars: Single Shot.

videos.title: Single Shot: Gay Stuff
videos.overview: Jerry's special guests Alec Baldwin, Larry David, Ricky Gervais, Barry Marder, Sarah Silverman and Howard Stern take their discussions out of the closet in this episode of Comedians in Cars: Single Shot.

videos.title: Single Shot: Comedians Love Eating
videos.overview: Jerry and his laundry list of guests deliberate over the one thing comedians love above all else. Food.

videos.title: Single Shot: Marriage

videos.title: Single Shot: The Money

videos.title: Single Shot: My Parents
videos.overview: Jerry and his special guests Larry David, Gad Elmaleh, Robert Klein, Jay Leno, Seth Meyers, Sarah Jessica Parker, Don Rickles, Sarah Silverman and Howard Stern reminisce about their humble roots in this episode of Comedians In Cars: Single Shot.

videos.title: Single Shot: Pee-Pee Time
videos.overview: Gotta go? Jerry and his special guests Mel Brooks, Larry David, Bob Einstein, Gad Elmaleh, Sarah Silverman, Howard Stern, and George Wallace can’t hold it any longer as they discuss the complexities of toilet time.

videos.overview: Jerry and his special guests Alec Baldwin, Larry David, Tina Fey, Robert Klein, Sarah Jessica Parker, Brian Regan and George Wallace confabulate apropos heterogeneous jargon while they luxuriate in coffee’s unequivocal piquancy.

videos.title: Single Shot: Real Jobs
videos.overview: Who WANTS to work? Jerry and his special guests Todd Barry, Louis C.K., Robert Klein, Seth Meyers, Patton Oswalt, Brian Regan, Jon Stewart and Colin Quinn reflect on the jobs that taught them... working sucks!

videos.title: Single Shot: Coffee or Tea?
videos.overview: Cream and sugar, or lemon and ice? Jerry and his special guests Larry David, Joel Hodgson and Michael Richards attempt to answer a question as old as time… Coffee or tea?

videos.title: Single Shot: Hair
videos.overview: Things get a little hairy when Jerry talks about the allure of a carefully sculpted coiffure with Louis C.K., Larry David, Tina Fey, Ricky Gervais and mop-top Howard Stern.

videos.title: Jason Alexander: The Over-Cheer
videos.overview: Jerry Seinfeld (Seinfeld) and his special guest, George Costanza, drive a 1976 American Motors Pacer to Tom's Restaurant for some coffee.

videos.title: Howard Stern: The Last Days of Howard Stern
videos.overview: Jerry Seinfeld (Seinfeld) and his special guest, Howard Stern (The Howard Stern Show), drive "The Judge" a 1969 Pontiac GTO to The Bel Aire Diner for some coffee in the season finale.

videos.title: Sarah Jessica Parker: A Little Hyper-Aware
videos.overview: Jerry Seinfeld and his special guest, Sarah Jessica Parker, sip a Starbucks while driving a 1976 Ford Country Station Wagon to Long Island’s Colony Diner ... for another cup of coffee.

videos.title: George Wallace: Two Polish Airline Pilots
videos.overview: Comedians Jerry Seinfeld and George Wallace reminisce about their over-35-year friendship while cruising the Las Vegas strip in a 1965 Buick Riviera before stopping at the famous Peppermill Restaurant.

videos.title: Robert Klein: Opera Pimp
videos.overview: Jerry Seinfeld and his hero, Robert Klein, cruise around Westchester County, NY, in a ‘67 Jaguar Mark II to look for lunch and a hot brew and somehow wind up at Sing Sing prison.

videos.title: Aziz Ansari: It's Like Pushing a Building Off a Cliff
videos.overview: Jerry takes the wheel of Aziz Ansari’s “flying brick,” a 2012 Prevost X3-45 VIP tour bus, and tries avoids trees and curbs before pulling into a truck stop diner for a quick meal and a cup o’ joe.

videos.title: Jon Stewart: The Sound of Virginity
videos.overview: When Jerry Seinfeld can no longer take driving a 1978 AMC Gremlin, guest Jon Stewart’s first car, he ditches it for its much bigger brother, a 1968 AMX, before they head over to the Tick Tock Diner in Clifton, NJ.

videos.title: Kevin Hart: You Look Amazing in the Wind
videos.overview: Jerry Seinfeld and his special guest Kevin Hart stylishly cruise around town in a 1959 Porsche RSK Spyder for their "weird male date." Plus special extra feature: "Dick Corcoran"

videos.title: Amy Schumer: I'm Wondering What It's Like to Date Me
videos.overview: Jerry Seinfeld and his special guest Amy Schumer check out “cute bongs” as they walk to a local diner for some coffee after their 1971 Ferrari Daytona breaks down.

videos.title: Bill Burr: Smoking Past the Band
videos.overview: Jerry Seinfeld and his special guest Bill Burr cruise around L.A. in a 1970 Ford Mustang like a couple of bosses out on the town in the middle of the day.

videos.title: Miranda Sings: Happy Thanksgiving Miranda
videos.overview: Jerry Seinfeld and his special guest Miranda Sings cruise around town in a 1960 Austin Healey Sprite in search of coffee, complaining and apologizing along the way.

videos.title: Fred Armisen: I Wasn't Told About This... With Special Feature: I'm Dying, Jerry
videos.overview: Jerry Seinfeld and his special guest Fred Armisen cruise over to Portland's Coava in a 1965 Saab 96 Monte Carlo 850 for some coffee.

videos.title: Ali Wentworth: I'm Going to Take a Percocet and Let That One Go
videos.overview: Jerry and his special guest, Ali Wentworth go out for a spin in a low grill 1970 Mercedes 280SE Cabriolet to wasply grab some coffee.

videos.title: Jimmy Fallon: The Unsinkable Legend: Part 1
videos.overview: Jerry and his special guest Jimmy Fallon cruise over to Jerry's actual car in a 1956 Chevy Corvette convertible to hop aboard yet another vehicle to enjoy some comedic sailing out at sea.

videos.title: Jimmy Fallon: The Unsinkable Legend: Part 2
videos.overview: Jerry and his special guest Jimmy Fallon finish up their day on the water and head back to the mainland for John's Famous Pancake House and a cup of coffee.

videos.title: Julia Louis-Dreyfus: I'll Go If I Don't Have To Talk
videos.overview: Jerry and the “James Bond of comedy” Julia Louis-Dreyfus reminisce as they share a cappuccino after cruising the Pacific Palisades in a 1964 Aston Martin DB5.

videos.title: Steve Harvey: Always Do the Banana Joke First
videos.overview: Jerry and Steve Harvey prowl Chicago in a ‘57 Chevy Bel Air convertible, enjoy some fine cigars and muse about offensive jokes and the futility of comedy class.

videos.title: Jim Carrey: We Love Breathing What You're Burning, Baby
videos.overview: Jerry’s full of testosterone as he steps into a ‘76 Lamborghini Countach with Jim Carrey, who’s between a three-week cleanse and a five-day silent retreat. After coffee, it’s off to Carrey’s studio to study a portrait of a gorilla with a machine gun. Wow.

videos.title: Bill Maher: The Comedy Team of Smug and Arrogant
videos.overview: Jerry chooses a 1979 VW Bug police car for good buddy Bill Maher because, as he says, Maher seems to have authority but actually has none. Case in point: when Maher talks politics, Jerry asks, “Boxers or briefs?”

videos.title: Trevor Noah: That's the Whole Point of Apartheid, Jerry
videos.overview: Jerry takes incoming Daily Show host Trevor Noah on a tour down under the Brooklyn Bridge, where they riff on football (aka, soccer), apartheid’s stupidity, and Noah’s insane daily routine.

videos.title: Stephen Colbert: Cut Up And Bloody But Looking Good
videos.overview: Jerry rides shotgun with Stephen Colbert in a 1964 Morgan Plus 4, a British import that says you just don’t care what people think. He’s a late-night madman, according to Jerry, who’s impressed with Colbert’s beard and the manly way he pretends to smoke a pipe.

videos.title: President Barack Obama: Just Tell Him You're the President
videos.overview: For the premiere episode of Season 7, Jerry takes President Barack Obama for a spin in a 1963 Corvette Stingray Split Window Coupe but finds it hard to spirit the leader of the free world off the White House grounds.

videos.title: Steve Martin: If You See This on a Toilet Seat, Don't Sit Down
videos.overview: Jerry goes up to the country with Steve Martin in a beautiful but delicate 1954 Siata 8v and come back to the city in something else altogether. In between they converse about confidence, quitting and the best opening lines.

videos.title: Kathleen Madigan & Chuck Martin: Stroked Out on a Hot Machine
videos.overview: Jerry takes Kathleen Madigan and her buddy Chuck Martin out for a spin in Los Angeles as they ponder the pejorative meaning of the word “tool” and wonder why dads get no sports shout-outs.

videos.title: Garry Shandling: It's Great That Garry Shandling Is Still Alive
videos.overview: Garry Shandling rides shotgun in a 1979 Porsche 930 as he and Jerry goof on Matthew McConaughey and the Dalai Lama during a trip to Seinfeld’s old New York street set.

videos.title: Sebastian Maniscalco: I Don't Think That's Bestiality
videos.overview: In a perfect combination of guy, car and moment, Sebastian Maniscalco cruises the streets of L.A. with Jerry in a ‘69 Camaro Z/28 and talks about growing up in a Sicilian family, his grooming habits and having a mean resting face.

videos.title: Will Ferrell: Mr. Ferrell, For the Last Time, We're Going to Ask You to Put the Cigar Out
videos.overview: Will Ferrell says the secret to his comedy is that he looks like a banker but acts like a nut, which is why Jerry picks him up in a “happy, silly” 1970 Plymouth Road Runner SuperBird for a mid-day break.

videos.title: Jim Gaffigan: Stick Around for the Pope
videos.overview: In the Season 8 premiere, Jerry roughs it with Jim Gaffigan in a 1977 Volkswagen Camper Bus, eats pastrami at the 2nd Avenue Deli.

videos.title: Margaret Cho: You Can Go Cho Again
videos.overview: Jerry and pal Margaret Cho grab coffee at LA's Highland Cafe in a 1967 Mazda Cosmo Sport. Next thing we know, he's opening for her at The Stress Factory in New Jersey.

videos.title: Judd Apatow: Escape from Syosset
videos.overview: Jerry grabs coffee with writer-director Judd Apatow at the 101 Coffee Shop in Los Angeles. The car: a 1968 Firebird 400 convertible.

videos.title: J.B. Smoove: Everybody Respects a Bloody Nose
videos.overview: Jerry is kaffeeklatsching in L.A. this week with funnyman J.B. Smoove. They’re headed for brew at 10 Speed Coffee in a 1964 Studebaker Avanti.

videos.title: Lorne Michaels: Everybody Likes to See the Monkeys
videos.overview: Jerry convinces comedy genius Lorne Michaels to open up about the show that made him famous. The car: a 1955 Mercedes 300SL Gullwing.

videos.title: John Oliver: What Kind of Human Animal Would Do This?
videos.overview: In the Season 8 finale, Jerry and John Oliver (The Daily Show, Last Week Tonight) go for a coffee and comedy run in a 1959 Triumph TR3.

videos.title: Kristen Wiig: The Volvo-ness
videos.overview: Jerry is ready to partay this week with comic goddess Kristen Wiig in the Season 9 premiere. The pair are taking a 1964 Volvo 122S Amazon to LA's iconic House of Pies.

videos.title: Norm MacDonald: A Rusty Car in the Rain
videos.overview: Jerry is taking funnyman Norm MacDonald for a coffee run in a 1958 Porsche Speedster. Destination: Jackson Hole Diner in Queens.

videos.title: Cedric the Entertainer: Dictators, Comics, and Preachers
videos.overview: Jerry is rolling out a 1958 Bentley S1 Continental for Cedric the Entertainer for a trip to The Butcher’s Daughter in NYC.

videos.title: Lewis Black: At What Point Am I Out From Under?
videos.overview: Jerry can’t take angry comedian Lewis Black anywhere. Watch Lewis rant with his mouth full at Junior's Cheesecake, and road-rage all over New York in a 1967 Cadillac Eldorado.

videos.title: Christoph Waltz: Champagne, Cigars, And Pancake Batter
videos.overview: Academy Award® winner and Austrian national treasure Christoph Waltz has never tasted an IHOP pancake. Enter Jerry Seinfeld and a 1957 BMW 507 Series II Roadster to right this grievous wrong.

videos.title: Bob Einstein: It's Not So Funny When It's Your Mother
videos.overview: In the season finale, Jerry’s buying pal Bob Einstein (aka Super Dave Osborne) coffee at Hollywood’s Urth Caffe and sandwiches at Bay Cities Deli & Bakery. If his guest is funny enough, Jerry might throw in a 2016 Acura NSX.

videos.title: Zach Galifianakis: From The Third Reich To You
videos.overview: Zach Galifianakis joins Jerry for bike shopping and doughnuts in a Volkswagen Thing before turning the tables and making Jerry sit between two ferns.

videos.title: Dave Chappelle: Nobody Says, “I Wish I Had a Camera"
videos.overview: In Washington, D.C., Jerry and Dave Chappelle take a ride in a 1973 Citroën Maserati SM and pay a visit to Dave's old high school.

videos.title: Ellen DeGeneres: You Said It Wasn’t Funny
videos.overview: Jerry picks up Ellen DeGeneres in a 1977 Toyota FJ40 Land Cruiser. They discuss her start in comedy, then Ellen teaches Jerry a lesson about car keys.

videos.title: Tracy Morgan: Lasagna With Six Different Cheeses
videos.overview: In a 1984 Ferrari 288 GTO, Jerry and Tracy Morgan do some grocery shopping, talk about raisins and hit a diner in Ridgewood, New Jersey.

videos.title: Brian Regan: Are There Left Handed Spoons?
videos.overview: Jerry picks up Brian Regan in Brian's favorite car, a Cadillac XLR convertible, and they get coffee and visit a golf shop (to Jerry's chagrin).

videos.title: Dana Carvey: Na.. Ga.. Do.. It
videos.overview: Dana Carvey and Jerry roll in a Meyers Manx dune buggy to the Beverly Hills Hotel for coffee, then Dana plays guitar for Jerry at a music store.

videos.title: Hasan Minhaj: Nobody Cries At A Joke
videos.overview: Jerry picks up basketball enthusiast Hasan Minhaj in a 1992 Ferrari 512 TR and tries to explain why baseball's better over coffee and pancakes.

videos.title: Neal Brennan: Red Bottom Shoes Equals Fantastic Babies
videos.overview: Jerry takes Neal Brennan to Hermosa Beach in a 1965 Porsche 356C Coupe to discuss comic philosophies and why they didn't watch each other's shows.

videos.title: John Mulaney: A Hooker in the Rain
videos.overview: In a 1969 Alfa Romeo Giulia Super, Jerry and John Mulaney do some rug shopping for John's apartment and head to Staten Island for pizza and coffee.

videos.title: Kate McKinnon: A Brain in a Jar
videos.overview: Kate McKinnon joins Jerry for a jaunt around Manhattan in a 1962 Fiat 600 Multipla, and they dive into topics like the Coriolis effect over coffee.

videos.title: Alec Baldwin: Gyrating, Naked Twister
videos.overview: Jerry picks up Alec Baldwin in a 1974 BMW 3.0 CS coupe, and they drive to their shared hometown of Massapequa, New York, to swap old stories.

videos.title: Jerry Lewis: Heere’s Jerry!
videos.overview: Jerry travels to Las Vegas in a 1966 Jaguar E-Type to spend time with his hero, Jerry Lewis, in what would be Lewis's final on-screen appearance.

videos.title: Eddie Murphy: I Just Wanted To Kill
videos.overview: Jerry picks up Eddie Murphy in a Porsche Carrera GT for a wide-ranging conversation about Eddie's career and coming up together in late-'70s New York.

videos.title: Seth Rogen: We Have The Meats
videos.overview: In a beat-up 1976 Dodge Monaco, Jerry and Seth Rogen get coffee and make an Arby's run while musing on fame, feelings, awards, beards and more.

videos.title: Ricky Gervais: China Maybe? Part 1
videos.overview: Jerry gets Ricky Gervais in a 2018 Rolls-Royce convertible, and their discussion includes whether or not to leave a stereotypical joke in the episode.

videos.title: Ricky Gervais: China Maybe? Part 2
videos.overview: Jerry and Ricky stop at a bakery, pounder unfunny comedians and Holocaust jokes, then try not to run out of things to say while stuck in traffic.

videos.title: Matthew Broderick: These People That Do This Stuff. They Stink.
videos.overview: In a 2018 Lamborghini Huracán, Jerry and Matthew Broderick roll by Matthew's old home, find trouble at Patagonia and live out a baseball fantasy.

videos.title: Jamie Foxx: You Got To Get The Alligator Sweat
videos.overview: Jerry takes a 1969 Maserati Mistral to New Orleans to meet Jamie Foxx. Jamie talks about his comedy inspiration and how he stays humble and hungry.

videos.title: Sebastian Maniscalco: My Wife Didn't Know The Extent Of It
videos.overview: Rolling around in vintage Italian scooters, Jerry and Sebastian Maniscalco discuss likes and dislikes and how comedians function in "normal" society.

videos.title: Martin Short: A Dream World Of Residuals
videos.overview: Martin Short talks about the '70s Toronto comedy scene and being funny on demand as he and Jerry drive around LA in a 1983 Mercedes station wagon.

videos.title: Mario Joyner: He Should Have Been Done That
videos.overview: In a 1974 VW Thing, Jerry and his old friend Mario Joyner hit up a barbershop, eat chicken and waffles, and discuss being a well-rounded entertainer.

videos.title: Melissa Villaseñor
videos.overview: Jerry and impressionist Melissa Villaseñor visit a Brooklyn food museum in a 1991 Nissan Figaro and talk funny voices and Silly Putty.

videos.title: Bridget Everett: Still Hot To The Touch
videos.overview: Cabaret performer Bridget Everett finds some pent-up anger in Jerry, and the pair get tarot readings while cruising in a 1961 Cadillac convertible.

videos.title: Barry Marder: Big Lots and BevMo!
videos.overview: Jerry picks up longtime friend Barry Marder in a 1966 Porsche 356 SC Cabriolet, and they rank bodily functions, go shopping and eat Twinkies.

awards: Nominated for 5 Primetime Emmys. 11 wins & 10 nominations total
